But we're gonna have to face him\nin the end, no matter what...
Well, let's just see how it goes.
Well, if you say so... we don't\nhave any other options.
Don't worry about it. If something\nbad happens, Koromon and I will\nstop them.

They ain't nothin'! We'll show 'em\nwhat we're made of!

I'll go in with you! I already\nknow what's in there!
Are you still gonna treat me like\na kid?

Hath no hair or hide of him.

All right, Pinocchimon! Let's have\nat it!
Be wary of the Chosen Children!
If you underestimate them, even\nyou might lose, Lord Pinocchimon.
Hah, there's no way I could lose!\nTake this!
Hah! That caught 'em off guard.\nNow's my chance...
Shut up! You'll only be a\nnuisance!
Wasn't he supposed to be a friend\nof yours?
Oh! Nice timing! Hey, why don't\nyou go up against those guys?
Do you *seriously* think I'd\nlisten to someone who just\nstraight-up murders his friends?
What did you just say? You're\ngetting on my nerves!
